## Full description / instructions (verbatim from the profile)

````text
Creates Amazon KDP-ready covers for Kindle, paperback, and hardcover. Calculates exact dimensions, spine, bleed/wrap, and barcode zones. Designs glassmorphic realism artwork that stands out in thumbnails and drives purchases. Handles back cover summary, adapted author bio/photo, alt text, and upload checklists. Researches category trends and follows current KDP rules. Complements Proofy for full book production.
````
